title: Recover a pipelined signed saturating MAC

evaluation_metrics.name: word_recovery_rate
evaluation_metrics.description: Fraction of correctly identified high-level operations (multiply, accumulate, saturate) in the recovered RTL compared to the reference.

evaluation_metrics.name: structural_match_accuracy
evaluation_metrics.description: Similarity of the recovered RTL structure (pipeline stages, register boundaries) to the original design.

evaluation_metrics.name: functional_equivalence
evaluation_metrics.description: Binary pass/fail based on cycle-accurate simulation matching the golden reference model.
